sources.entry: Screentendo - Turn your screen into a playable level of Mario.

summary.one_liner: Screentendo is a macOS desktop app that turns a selected area of your screen into a playable Super Mario Bros. level.
summary.what_it_does: Screentendo lets you select a portion of your screen and converts it into a playable level of Super Mario Bros. The README describes it as a desktop application and gives setup steps for building it from source. It is listed in a macOS apps collection under Games. The README is brief and does not describe controls, features in detail, or how the screen capture works. It points to an external link for more information about the project.
use_cases: Playing Mario on a screen region
Turning on-screen content into a game level
Playing a novelty game on macOS
Exploring a Cocoapods-based macOS sample project
how_to_run: From the root of the project, run: pod install
Open Screentendo.xcworkspace in Xcode to launch the project
notable: Converts a selected screen area into a playable Super Mario Bros. level
Desktop app built with Xcode and Cocoapods
Listed among macOS apps in a games category
caveats: Requires Xcode and Cocoapods to build from source
README is brief and gives no detail on features, controls, or supported macOS versions
